qrRole: entry URL and Fog Child placement marker
tracking: QR corners / local camera / 34mm / retain last camera-relative pose when QR leaves view
interaction: QR creates the native Unity radio / touch while speaking / release / absorb into the original dial hole / child emerges from speaker grille with automatic music / choices after 6 seconds
music: On-device StoryMusic worker / voice-derived 48-80 second loop / no generation API or voice upload
audio: Automatic room bed and exhibition-voice guidance / HRTF story music / ref 35cm, rolloff 0.7 / guide stops before recording
touchFeedback: Short water-like tones from the music pitch palette / spatial / fades when recording opens
visuals: Native Unity meshes and PBR maps / original dial and grille anchors / DrawIntoHole and Story Voice Mist port / 61 inner ice instances and 43 inner fog particles
finish: Close the browser window if allowed; otherwise a brief farewell
performance: QR worker / DPR cap 1.5 / 256px bloom / 30fps idle radio, up to 60fps active / allocation-free UI projection / update DOM and spatial audio only on movement / skip empty mist / stop rendering on hide and finish
innerMotion: 61 dynamic native ice instances / independent rotation and position / music-driven speed, size and light / spread constrained within the body
surfaceMotion: Local vertex bulges follow RMS, bass and midrange / smooth attack and release / bounded 0.16 model-space deformation
restart: Stop and disconnect generated music / discard recording and worker / reset musical reaction and progress / hide old child / restore radio, touch icon and room BGM
defaultLanguage: Device primary language: ko/en/ja; otherwise en

narrationVoice.delivery: 24 pre-recorded local WAV files; no speech API during visits

arCompositing: Body, voice mist, inner fog and bloom retain canvas alpha / transparent bloom clear / WebGL 1 and 2 shader and pixel-coverage regression
touchGuide: Icon-only animated finger at the native radio dial hole / follows QR pose and viewport / hidden during recording, creation, music and finish / returns for another story
